title: CHAPTER X. Anne's Apology
chineseTitle: 第 10 章：安妮的赔礼道歉

paragraphs.en: Marilla did not discuss Anne’s behavior with Matthew that evening but had to explain the next morning when Anne refused breakfast. Marilla detailed the incident, emphasizing how badly Anne behaved.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，玛丽拉没有和马修讨论安妮的行为，但第二天早上安妮拒绝吃早餐时，她不得不解释这件事。玛丽拉详细讲述了整个事件，强调了安妮表现得有多么糟糕。

paragraphs.en: "Rachel Lynde got a good lesson," Matthew said comfortingly.
paragraphs.zh: “雷切尔·林德上了一堂不错的课，”马修安慰地说。

paragraphs.en: "Matthew Cuthbert, I’m astonished at you! You know Anne’s actions were terrible and yet you defend her!" Marilla retorted.
paragraphs.zh: “马修，我对你真是失望！你知道安妮的行为很糟糕，却还为她辩护！”玛丽拉说道。

paragraphs.en: "Well—no—not exactly," Matthew replied uneasily. "She should be punished a little, but don’t be too hard on her. She hasn’t had anyone to teach her right."
paragraphs.zh: “嗯——不完全是这样，”马修不安地回答，“她确实应该受到一点惩罚，但也不要太过严厉。她毕竟没人教过她什么是正确的行为。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla insisted that Anne would eat regularly but stay in the east gable until she apologized to Mrs. Lynde.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉坚持让安妮按时吃饭，但要待在东屋，直到向林德太太道歉。

paragraphs.en: Breakfast, lunch, and dinner were silent as Anne remained stubborn. Marilla brought up well-filled trays each meal and later found them nearly full, causing Matthew concern about whether Anne had eaten.
paragraphs.zh: 早餐、午餐和晚餐都异常安静，因为安妮坚持不说话。玛丽拉每次端上的餐盘都满满当当，但后来发现食物几乎原封未动，这让马修开始担心安妮是否真的吃过了。

paragraphs.en: That evening, after Marilla went to bring cows from the back pasture, Matthew sneaked into the house and crept upstairs. He hadn’t been there since helping paper a spare room four years ago.
paragraphs.zh: 那天晚上，玛丽拉去后牧场接牛之后，马修悄悄进了屋，蹑手蹑脚地上了楼。自从四年前帮忙粉刷一间备用房间以来，他还没来过这里。

paragraphs.en: Matthew tiptoed down the hall, hesitated outside the east gable door for several minutes, then tapped softly and peeked inside. Anne sat in the yellow chair by the window, looking small and unhappy. Matthew’s heart ached as he closed the door quietly and approached her.
paragraphs.zh: 马修轻手轻脚地下了走廊，在东面山墙的门前犹豫了几分钟，然后轻轻敲了敲门缝，探头往里看。安妮坐在窗边的黄色椅子上，显得矮小而愁眉不展。马修的心疼了一下，默默地关上门，走近她身边。

paragraphs.en: "Anne," he whispered, "how are you making it?" Anne smiled weakly.
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，”他低语道，“你过得怎么样？”安妮勉强笑了笑。

paragraphs.en: Anne smiled, facing her solitary future bravely. Matthew urged her to apologize to Mrs. Lynde, warning that Marilla was very determined. Anne agreed reluctantly, saying she felt ashamed but couldn't face telling Mrs. Lynde directly.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮勇敢地面对着孤寂的未来，微微一笑。马修催促她向林德太太道歉，警告说玛丽拉态度非常坚决。安妮勉强同意了，表示自己感到羞愧，但无法直接告诉林德太太这件事。

paragraphs.en: "Go smooth things over," Matthew encouraged. "I'll keep quiet about it."
paragraphs.zh: “你去圆圆这个圈吧，”马修鼓励她说，“我暂时不提这件事。”

paragraphs.en: Anne went to tell Marilla as soon as she returned. She admitted her mistake and expressed willingness to apologize to Mrs. Lynde. Relieved, Matthew quickly fled to avoid suspicion.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮一回到家就去找玛丽拉，承认了自己的错误，并表示愿意向林德太太道歉。听到这里，马修如释重负地赶紧溜走了，以免引起怀疑。

paragraphs.en: Marilla's sternness hid her relief as they prepared to walk down the lane after milking. Anne initially looked dejected but soon brightened, her eyes fixed on the sunset sky.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉虽然表面上板着脸，但看到他们准备去牛栏外散步时松了口气。安妮起初显得有些沮丧，但很快脸上露出了笑容，目光紧紧盯着晚霞映红的天空。

paragraphs.en: "Thinking about what I'll say to Mrs. Lynde," Anne replied dreamily when asked by Marilla.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮被问及她将如何向雷切尔·林德夫人解释时，梦呓般地回答道：“我在想着该怎么跟雷切尔夫人说呢。”

paragraphs.en: Despite this, Marilla sensed something was amiss in her plan. Anne's radiant demeanor troubled her.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管如此，玛丽拉还是觉得自己的计划出了问题。安妮那灿烂的表情让她感到不安。

paragraphs.en: Approaching Mrs. Lynde’s kitchen window, Anne suddenly knelt before the surprised woman and pleaded for forgiveness.
paragraphs.zh: 走近雷切尔·林德太太的厨房窗前，安妮突然跪在惊讶的她面前，恳求她的原谅。

paragraphs.en: "Oh, Mrs. Lynde, I am so sorry," Anne said with a quiver. "I can't express how much I regret my behavior. You must imagine it.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，雷切尔·林德太太，我真是太抱歉了，”安妮声音颤抖地说，“我的悔意无法用言语表达。请您想象一下吧。”

paragraphs.en: I've been terrible to you and have disgraced Matthew and Marilla by staying at Green Gables. I'm wicked and ungrateful, deserving eternal punishment."
paragraphs.zh: 我对你太糟糕了，还让马修和玛丽拉在绿山墙丢脸。我真是罪孽深重、不知感恩， deserves 永远的惩罚。

paragraphs.en: Anne continued, her voice breaking: "It was wrong of me to fly into a temper when you told the truth. Every word you said was true—my hair is red, I’m freckled, skinny, and ugly. What I said to you was also true, but I shouldn’t have spoken.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮继续说道，声音有些哽咽：“我本不该在你讲真话时发脾气。你所说的每一句话都是真的——我的头发是红色的，满脸雀斑，瘦弱又难看。我说的话也是对的，但我本不应该开口。”

paragraphs.en: Please forgive me, Mrs. Lynde. It would be a lifelong sorrow for this poor orphan girl if you didn't."
paragraphs.zh: 请原谅我，雷切尔·林德太太。如果得不到您的原谅，这对这个可怜的孤儿来说将是终生的遗憾。

paragraphs.en: She clasped her hands and waited anxiously for Mrs. Lynde's response.
paragraphs.zh: 她双手交叉，焦虑地等待着雷切尔·林德夫人的回应。

paragraphs.en: Anne's sincerity was evident in her voice, and Marilla and Mrs. Lynde both noticed it. However, Marilla was dismayed to see that Anne seemed to be enjoying her punishment, reveling in the depth of her humiliation. The supposed wholesome lesson had turned into a form of pleasure for Anne.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮的声音里充满了真诚，玛丽拉和雷切尔·林德太太都注意到了这一点。然而，令玛丽拉失望的是，她发现安妮似乎在享受这种惩罚，沉浸于自己屈辱的深度之中。原本应该有益的一课，竟成了安妮的一种乐趣。

paragraphs.en: Mrs. Lynde, not overly perceptive, saw only that Anne had given a thorough apology and forgave her readily. "There, there, get up, child," she said warmly. "Of course I forgive you.
paragraphs.zh: 雷切尔·林德夫人并不太敏感，只见安妮已经真诚地道歉了，便轻易原谅了她。“好了，好了，孩子，站起来吧，”她热情地说，“当然我会原谅你的。”

paragraphs.en: I guess I was too hard on you. But I'm such an outspoken person—just don't mind me."
paragraphs.zh: 我想我对你要求得太严了。但我这个人直来直去的——你别介意。

paragraphs.en: Anne stood up, relieved. "Mrs. Lynde, you've given me hope. You'll always be a benefactor to me.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮站起身来，松了口气。“雷切尔·林德太太，您让我看到了希望。您永远都会是我的恩人。”

paragraphs.en: If my hair turns auburn as I grow older, it would make being good so much easier, wouldn't it? Can I go sit on the bench in your garden while you and Marilla talk?"
paragraphs.zh: 要是我年纪大了头发变成红褐色，做好人岂不是容易多了？要不我在你们谈话的时候坐在花园里的长凳上好了。

paragraphs.en: "Go ahead, child," Mrs. Lynde replied. "You can pick some of those white June lilies over there if you like."
paragraphs.zh: “去吧，孩子，”雷切尔·林德太太回答道，“如果你喜欢的话，可以摘那些白百合花。”

paragraphs.en: As Anne left, Mrs. Lynde quickly lit a lamp.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮离开时，雷切尔·林德夫人迅速点亮了一盏灯。

paragraphs.en: Anne emerged from the orchard, holding a bunch of white narcissus, as they walked down the lane.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮手持一束白色水仙，从果园里走出来，在小路上与他们并肩而行。

paragraphs.en: "Did I apologize well enough?" she asked proudly.
paragraphs.zh: “我道歉够诚恳了吗？”她自豪地问道。

paragraphs.en: Marilla replied, "You did it thoroughly."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉回答说：“你做得彻底。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla found herself tempted to laugh at the memory but decided not to scold Anne for her apology. Instead, she said sternly, "I hope you won't need to make many more such apologies. Try to control your temper now, Anne."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉发现自己忍不住想笑，但还是决定不责怪安妮的道歉。她严肃地说：“我希望你以后不需要再做这样的道歉了。现在试着控制好自己的情绪吧，安妮。”

paragraphs.en: Anne sighed, saying, "It wouldn't be so hard if people didn't tease me about my looks." She added, "I don't get cross about other things; but I'm tired of being teased about my hair and it makes me boil over. Do you think my hair will turn into a handsome auburn when I grow up?"
paragraphs.zh: 安妮叹了口气，说道：“如果人们不再取笑我的相貌，这事儿就不会那么难了。”她又补充道，“我对其他事情倒不至于生气；但被取笑头发的事我已经厌烦透了，这让我气不打一处来。你觉得等我长大后，我的头发会不会变成漂亮的栗色呢？”

paragraphs.en: Marilla advised, "You shouldn't focus so much on your appearance, Anne. You are a very vain little girl."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉建议说：“安妮，你不应该这么在意自己的外表。你这个小姑娘真是非常爱慕虚荣。”

paragraphs.en: Anne protested, "How can I be vain when I know I'm homely? I love pretty things and hate seeing something unattractive in the mirror. It makes me feel sorrowful—just like looking at any ugly thing."
paragraphs.zh: 安妮抗议说：“我怎么能自以为美呢？我知道自己相貌平平。我喜欢漂亮的东西，见不得镜子里有什么不吸引人的东西，这让我感到难过——就像看到任何丑陋的东西一样。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla quoted, "Handsome is as handsome does." Anne sniffed her narcissi, then said, "These flowers are so sweet. Mrs. Lynde gave them to me; I no longer hold a grudge against her.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉引用道：“好看的也是靠本事的。”安妮嗅了嗅自己的水仙花，然后说：“这些花真香。雷切尔·林德送给了我，我现在对她也没有什么怨言了。

paragraphs.en: Apologizing and being forgiven feels wonderful."
paragraphs.zh: 道歉并得到原谅的感觉真是美妙。

paragraphs.en: "Anne, stop daydreaming," Marilla said, tired of following Anne's thoughts.
paragraphs.zh: “安妮，别再做白日梦了。”玛丽拉说道，已经厌倦了跟着安妮的思绪。

paragraphs.en: As they turned into their lane, a gypsy wind carried the scent of dew-wet ferns. A light shone from Green Gables' kitchen. Anne approached Marilla, holding her hand tightly.
paragraphs.zh: 当他们拐进自家的小路时，一阵吉普赛风带来了潮湿蕨类植物的清新香气。绿山墙农舍厨房里透出微弱的灯光。安妮紧紧握住玛丽拉的手，走近她。

paragraphs.en: "It’s lovely to be going home and know it’s home," she said. "I love Green Gables already; I’ve never loved any place before."
paragraphs.zh: “回家并且知道这就是家的感觉真好，”她说，“我已经爱上了绿山墙，以前我从没有如此热爱过任何地方。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla felt a warm, unfamiliar sensation in her heart, perhaps a maternal feeling she had missed. She quickly restored her composure by saying, "If you’re a good girl, you’ll always be happy. And you shouldn’t find it hard to pray."
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉心中涌起一股温暖而陌生的感觉，或许这就是她久违的母爱之情。她迅速恢复镇定，说道：“如果你是个好孩子，就会永远快乐。你也不应该觉得祈祷很难。”

paragraphs.en: Anne pondered, "Praying isn't exactly the same as saying one's prayers." Then she said, "I'll imagine I'm the wind in those tree tops, then gently waving among ferns, dancing flowers at Mrs. Lynde’s garden, and rippling the Lake of Shining Waters. There’s so much imagination in a wind.
paragraphs.zh: 安妮思索着，“祈祷和念祷告词可不太一样。”然后她说道：“我要想象自己是那些树梢间的风，轻轻拂过蕨类植物，舞动莱恩德太太花园里的花朵，在闪耀湖面上荡起涟漪。风中的想象力真是无穷啊。”

paragraphs.en: So I won’t talk anymore."
paragraphs.zh: “那么我就不再多说。”

paragraphs.en: Marilla sighed in relief, grateful for the silence.
paragraphs.zh: 玛丽拉松了口气，感激这难得的宁静。
